title: Concept: tx.origin used for authorization (solidity) — review required
description: In solidity, the check compares the transaction originator. A phishing contract relays a call from the victim, so the origin still matches the owner. The remedy is msg.sender.
applicability: solidity contracts with owner or role checks; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Unauthorized privileged actions through a phishing contract; HIGH severity.
